gates.detail: The maintainer uploaded and compiled three documents on Overleaf (TeX Live 2026, pdfTeX 1.40.29) with and without the word cache; see the review record. A new-word edit in the browser, copy-paste and visual review of the new styles were not reported, so this gate remains pending.
A person other than the implementation agent must reproduce the documented installation from a clean source archive.
Maintainer accepted the three-page regular specimen associated with dbeab3c. New automatic/bold/slanted specimens and broader corpus review are not covered; this release gate remains pending.

The prior 100-page distinct-token workload exceeded 90 seconds and has not been re-measured. With the word cache, recompiling a 4,984-word document took 2.5 s on Overleaf instead of 37.8 s, but a first compile still shapes every distinct word at roughly 100-150 words per second. The maintainer decides whether this meets the interactive target.

Release archives now include the unmodified Noto Serif Bengali Regular and Bold binaries with the complete OFL 1.1 text and FONT-NOTICES.md; the source repository does not. The maintainer must confirm this distribution before publication.
BnTeX remains a working name. CTAN catalogue/name-confusion review and any maintainer discussion have not been finalized.
Current authorization covers private consolidation and release preparation only, not public GitHub releases, visibility changes, CTAN or PyPI publication.
